export type BillingCycle = "monthly" | "yearly"

export type PricingPlan = {
  id: "hobby" | "pro" | "teams" | "enterprise"
  name: string
  monthly: { price: string }
  yearly: { price: string }
  intro: string
  features: string[]
  ctaLabel: string
  ctaVariant?: "default" | "outline"
}
